title: Mechanistic study of a triterpenoid-enriched fraction derived from Cynomorium songaricum against NAFLD: An integrative elucidation.
authors: Liu, Zhihao; Shang, Qixiang; Cheng, Juanjuan; He, Quanrun; Liu, Yining; Li, Haimeng; Fang, Daozheng; Li, Xinyue; Zhu, Yong; Chen, Jianping; Chen, Jihang
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物提取物对非酒精性脂肪肝的疗效机制，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is a growing global health concern linked to metabolic dysfunction and inflammation. Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM), with its emphasis on restoring balance and harmony within the body, is well-suited to address the heterogeneity of NAFLD. Effective strategies to manage NAFLD remain limited, emphasizing the need for novel bioactive compounds with therapeutic potential. PURPOSE: This study aimed to investigate the protective effects of a triterpenoid-enriched fraction (CST) derived from Cynomorium songaricum and its active compounds on NAFLD and to elucidate their underlying mechanisms. METHODS: CST composition was analyzed using UHPLC/ESI-LTQ-Orbitrap-MS. Anti-inflammatory and lipid-lowering effects were assessed through in vitro and in vivo experiments. Integration of RNA-seq and novel network pharmacology identified key molecular targets, while molecular docking confirmed interactions of oleanolic acid (OLA) and ursolic acid (UA) with IKBKB and TACE, crucial components of the NF-kappaB pathway. RESULTS: CST, OLA and UA significantly reduced lipid accumulation and downregulated inflammatory markers, including TNF-alpha and lipogenesis-related genes in vitro. In vivo, these compounds reduced lipid accumulation and modulated NF-kappaB activation, demonstrating robust anti-inflammatory and lipid-regulating effects. CONCLUSION: CST exhibits promising bioactive properties in managing NAFLD. IKBKB and TACE mediate CST's protective effects against NAFLD by suppressing NF-kappaB target genes, reducing TNF-alpha, and inhibiting lipogenesis. These findings provide a foundation for developing CST and its active components, OLA and UA, as potential therapeutic agents for NAFLD.
abstract_zh: 背景：非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）是一个日益严重的全球健康问题，与代谢功能障碍和炎症相关。传统中医药（TCM）强调恢复体内平衡与和谐，适合应对NAFLD的异质性。目前管理NAFLD的有效策略仍然有限，亟需具有治疗潜力的新型生物活性化合物。目的：本研究旨在探讨源自锁阳（Cynomorium songaricum）的三萜富集组分（CST）及其活性化合物对NAFLD的保护作用，并阐明其潜在机制。方法：采用UHPLC/ESI-LTQ-Orbitrap-MS分析CST组成。通过体外和体内实验评估抗炎和降脂效果。整合RNA-seq和新型网络药理学确定关键分子靶点，同时分子对接确认了齐墩果酸（OLA）和熊果酸（UA）与IKBKB和TACE的相互作用，这些是NF-kappaB通路的关键组分。结果：CST、OLA和UA在体外显著减少脂质积累并下调炎症标志物，包括TNF-alpha和脂肪生成相关基因。在体内，这些化合物减少脂质积累并调节NF-kappaB激活，展现出强大的抗炎和脂质调节作用。结论：CST在管理NAFLD中表现出有前景的生物活性特性。IKBKB和TACE通过抑制NF-kappaB靶基因、减少TNF-alpha和抑制脂肪生成，介导CST对NAFLD的保护作用。这些发现为开发CST及其活性成分OLA和UA作为NAFLD的潜在治疗药物奠定了基础。
